text:
jaya: sec-bot flagged a spike of SSO MFA prompts hitting ~8 accounts over 12m. Users are getting locked out, some report multiple push notifications. Looks like rotating IPs across EE regions. Investigating now.
security-bot: ALERT: SSO_ANOMALY_HIGH - 203 push attempts, 8 unique principals, src IPs clustered 185.92.x.x, 92.63.x.x, heuristic=prompt_surge. Ticket #SEC-2026 created.
sam: which environments? prod only or also staging?
jaya: prod orgs only (customer-facing and internal admin accounts). A few are support@ and infra@ service accounts showing retries.
olivia: immediate mitigations: 1) add temporary WAF firewall block for the IP ranges, 2) bump IdP backoff for push challenges, 3) revoke sessions for impacted accounts. Recommend not to mass-reset KMS keys unless evidence of compromise.
matt: oncall here. Applying CF block now. Command: `cloudflare rules create --mode block --expression "ip.src in {185.92.0.0/16 92.63.0.0/16}" --notes "SSO prompt surge 1854002468"` — done. Added rule id cf-fw-772.
sam: thanks. I can push an IdP rate-limit rule. Which provider? Okta.
olivia: Okta: enable global backoff on push and increase device challenge cooldown to 60s for now. Also enable email-only step-up for org-admins if push shows abuse.
jaya: start revoking refresh tokens for the 8 accounts: `adminctl sessions revoke --user support@redwood.com --reason "MFA prompt attack"` — please confirm before mass revocation.
matt: revoked refresh tokens for 7 affected accounts, left the shared infra account paused for manual review. `adminctl` returned 200 for each. Notified support desk to expect login help tickets.
security-bot: ACTION_LOG: firewall rule cf-fw-772 applied; 7 session revokes; ticket SEC-2026 updated with runbook steps and correlation logs (auth.log snippet attached).
sam: do we need to rotate any API keys or service principal credentials? I think the infra account showing retries might be misconfigured automation; flagged for secrets rotation after we finish triage.
olivia: agree. Post-incident follow-up: 1) add detection rule for "MFA prompt burst per principal > 10 in 10m", 2) tune rate limits at IdP, 3) add an automated responder to temporarily quiesce push notifications for affected principals to avoid MFA fatigue.
jaya: assigning follow-ups: @sam to implement detection rule and Okta cooldown change (owner: sam), @olivia to document postmortem and update runbook (owner: olivia), @matt to complete infra account secrets rotation and final verification (owner: matt). I'll draft a short customer-facing blurb for affected customers.
matt: infra account rotation started — replacing service principal creds and validating CI pipelines. ETA 90m.
sam: detection rule PR opened: https://git.internal/repo/pull/542. Includes metrics dashboard and alert thresholds.
olivia: wrote initial comms draft in #customers-ops, linking the incident ticket. No evidence of data exfiltration so far.
jaya: closing immediate response — keep ticket open for follow-up items. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:
security-bot: NOTE: next steps scheduled: postmortem meeting 2025-11-12 15:00 UTC, auto-notify owners."
